name: Strict Muscle-Up
description: The strict muscle-up is an advanced calisthenics movement requiring the lifter to transition from a dead hang to a straight-arm support position above a bar or rings using controlled pulling and pressing strength — without momentum or kipping. It demands exceptional lat, biceps, and triceps strength alongside scapular and core stability.

execution.starting_position: Hang from a pull-up bar with a false grip (wrists slightly over the bar) and a grip slightly narrower than shoulder width. Body in a hollow position.
execution.setup_instructions: A false grip (wrist over the bar) is critical — it allows the transition from pulling to pressing without re-gripping. Practice the false grip on the bar before attempting a full rep.
steps: Step 1: Begin in a dead hang with a false grip and hollow-body tension.
Step 2: Pull explosively and forcefully, bringing the chest high — above the bar if possible.
Step 3: As the chest clears the bar, aggressively lean the torso forward over the bar.
Step 4: Transition by pressing the bar down as the hips hinge over it, shifting to a support position.
Step 5: Lock out the elbows to reach the dip support position at the top.
Step 6: Lower back through the transition phase under control to the hanging start.
execution.breathing_instructions: Inhale before initiating. Exhale through the pull phase. Hold through the transition.
common_mistakes: Attempting without a false grip — the transition will be impossible without it
Not pulling high enough to initiate the transition over the bar
Using kipping momentum rather than pure strength
safety_considerations: Prerequisites: comfortably perform 15+ pull-ups and 15+ dips before attempting
Build toward this movement with negative muscle-ups and weighted pull-ups
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Dead hang to full lockout in the support position above the bar.
coaching_cues: Pull the bar to your hips, not your chin
Lean aggressively over the bar during the transition
Think of it as a high pull followed by a triceps press-down
